name: GitLab MCP (zereight)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C8, C9, C10; partly meets C5.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @zereight/mcp-gitlab@2.3.27 names the repository `git+https://github.com/zereight/gitlab-mcp.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 2.3.27 is dated 2026-11-13; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-14; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-14.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 31 advisories are published in the repository's advisory list; each names a patched version at or below the latest release (2.3.27). Most recent: GHSA-mfp5-5gv8-2ph2 (high, published 2026-11-13, patched in 2.3.27).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README documents permission modes; the default is `full`. Quoted: “`--permission-mode` - Permission level: `readonly`, `modify` (no delete or teardown tools), or `full` (replaces `GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE`, default `full`)”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The token is supplied through an environment variable, or OAuth. Quoted: “read -rs GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN && export GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README describes an opt-in local audit log; no usage collection by the publisher is described. Quoted: “Opt-in NDJSON audit log of MCP tool calls for SIEM ingestion”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README names prompt injection as a risk for the raw API tool and documents that the tool is only enabled explicitly. Quoted: “Prompt injection can drive it. Enable it only by listing `api` in `GITLAB_TOOLSETS`.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.29.0. Lower-bound version 1.29.0 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2026-03-30, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.

execute_graphql defeats read-only mode and GITLAB_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
